{C:81908400}{C:819582965F1E00000000}Welcome to Von Braun.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296601E00000000}Thank you
for allowing us to dock.
I'm Captain Rie Akatsuki.


{C:81908400}{C:81958296611E00000000}You're the captain?!
...No, forgive me.

{C:81958296621E00000000}I am Captain Quattro Bajeena
of AEUG.
We welcome your ship into port.

{C:81958296631E00000000}Please, make yourselves comfortable for now.
I have some business to attend to,
so let's talk later.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296641E00000000}Yes.
Thank you very much.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296651E00000000}That Quattro fellow...
I feel like I've seen him before.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296661E00000000}So, what are we going to do?
Since we're here, why don't we find out
what's going on in this city?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296671E00000000}Good idea.
Let's do that.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296681E00000000}Hmph! I'm coming too, you know.

{C:81908200}{C:81958296691E00000000}Hey, you lot!

{C:819582966A1E00000000}Since you've docked at Von Braun,
you're going to help AEUG, of course, right?!

rows.en:
{C:81908400}{C:81958296801E00000000}It seems {C:819782830400}Kamille{C:819782830000} behaved rudely earlier.
I'm sorry.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296811E00000000}Kamille?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296821E00000000}He must mean that guy from before.
You know, the one who tried to punch us.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296831E00000000}Oh.
Is he someone you know,
Captain Quattro?


{C:81908400}{C:81958296841E00000000}He's a talented pilot,
but rather headstrong.
Even we have trouble handling him.

{C:81958296851E00000000}I've set him straight.
In light of that, would you be willing
to hear me out?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296861E00000000}With all due respect,
someone who resorts to violence
against people he's just met...


{C:81930100}{C:81958296871E00000000}Stop it, Nelfea.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296881E00000000}But...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296891E00000000}Captain Quattro's apologizing, too.
Besides, we don't know the situation
on this continent, do we?

{C:81900300}{C:819582968A1E00000000}Right, right.
Big brother's right.

{C:81900400}{C:819582968B1E00000000}Oh, you're just obsessed with your brother.

{C:81900300}{C:819582968C1E00000000}What was that?!

{C:81930100}{C:819582968D1E00000000}Both of you, stop it.
You're embarrassing yourselves.

{C:819582968E1E00000000}Sorry, Captain Quattro.
Could you tell us what you wanted to say?

{C:81908400}{C:819582968F1E00000000}Thank you.
Let's go somewhere else so we can talk at leisure.
Come along.

rows.en:
{C:81908400}{C:81958296901E00000000}So the Titans have joined forces with Posaydal's army,
and we in AEUG
are being driven into a corner.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296911E00000000}I see.
So you need all the fighting strength
you can get?

{C:81908400}{C:81958296931E00000000}That is part of it...
but I'm concerned about a presence I sense
behind this conflict.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296941E00000000}What do you think it is,
Captain Quattro?

{C:81908400}{C:81958296951E00000000}...An enemy other than Posaydal
or the Titans.

{C:81958296961E00000000}I see it as a third force,
so to speak.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296971E00000000}A third force...?

{C:81908400}{C:81958296981E00000000}I suspect that the enemy we must fight
is that presence
behind the scenes.

{C:81958296991E00000000}It's only a hunch, though.

{C:81930100}{C:819582969A1E00000000}Captain Quattro, have you ever seen
a ship with the same shape
as ours?

{C:81908400}{C:819582969B1E00000000}A ship of the same type...
I've heard reports that one landed in another city.

{C:819582969C1E00000000}I understand they're hostile to you.
Am I wrong?

{C:81900300}{C:819582969D1E00000000}You're quite right.
We crossed the Cloud Sea
in pursuit of that ship.

{C:81908400}{C:819582969E1E00000000}Then I would like your help.
No, rather, I'd like you to let us help you.
What do you say?


{C:81900400}{C:819582969F1E00000000}What do we do, Rie?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296A21E00000000}Well... Wait,
what?! I have to decide?!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296A31E00000000}Of course. You're the captain.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296A41E00000000}...All right, Captain Quattro.
We'll help you.


{x00}

{C:81908400}{C:81958296A51E00000000}Thank you, Rie.

{C:81958296A61E00000000}I'll go on ahead and wait for you at the {C:819782830300}airport{C:819782830000}.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296A91E00000000}I think it might be a ship
